title: Thai Nimble Stir Fry
description: A spicy and flavorful stir-fry dish combining nimble and southern flavors, served with fresh tomatoes. This dish is quick to make and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the nimble and southern and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Add the kanom and ko and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the chopped tomatoes and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
